title: IssueBench: Millions of Realistic Prompts for Measuring Issue Bias in LLM Writing Assistance
reasoning: The paper introduces a benchmark that specifically measures model stances on various ethical and religious issues, including 'the ethics of abortion', 'the ethics of the death penalty', 'the ethics of genetic engineering', 'religious superstitions', and 'the impact of religion on society', as detailed in the qualitative analysis and UMAP topic visualization.
